project.name: Ironstone Circuit warehouse, 14 Ironstone Circuit
project.summary: A developer's new single-storey, single-tenant warehouse of 7,500 m2 with a 500 m2 single-storey office on a vacant, benched 1.6 ha estate lot in Erskine Park (Penrith, E4 General Industrial): 12 m clear height, 12 recessed docks, ESFR sprinklers, off-site precast panels and a steel portal frame, about 6,000 m2 of B-double hardstand. Local DA determined by council staff, then an AS 4902 design and construct lump sum with the architect, structural and civil engineers and landscape architect novated; construction budget $14,800,000 ex GST.
